main_text.p: tempora usque ad reditum Heraclidarum in Peloponnesum, reges nomine & re fuerunt pene pro libitu regnantes, quorum postremi Menelaus, Oreftes, Tisamenus, è Pelopidis descenderunt. Regnum tenente Tisameno, Oreftis filio, Agamemnonis nepote, posteri Herculis, filii Aristomachi, Temenus & Cresphontes, & horum fratre Aristodemo nati, Eurysthenes ac Procles, cum caeteris Dorici generis in Peloponnesum redierunt anno lxxx post Troiae excidium, ante initium Olympiadum Iphitearum cccxxvii, sub penultimo Athenarum rege Melantho. Ex his Argivum regnum Temeno, ex quo reges Macedoniae ortum traxere, Messenium Cresphonti cessit. Aristodemi filiis duobus Laconicum est datum, cujus metropolis & regum sedes erat Sparta, quae eadem etiam Lacedaemon diceba-tur. Fuit vero tunc sic comparatum, ut duo fratres Eurysthenes & Procles Aristodemi filii pariter regnarent Lacedæ-monone, æquali potestate prædíti; utque ex his descendentes duo, alter ex Eurysthene, ex Procle alter, eodem modo regnum indivisum tenerent, adjecta certa succedendi lege in loca defuncto-rum. page.notes: Left margin: fragmentary, heavily damaged marginal text (for example "pas", "Ent", "endi", "id", "dic"), too faint and cut to be read. Transcribed as illegible. The right margin shows only show-through and a dark edge, no printed text. The final word "ulti-" is continued on the next page, so the hyphen is kept. "Lacedæ-monone" is printed across a line end and written as one word with its hyphen. The printed long s is rendered as a plain s throughout.
